name: All's Well That Ends Well
summary: Friz Frazzlespark says the Venture Co. has paid for its part in the deal, and she has received her loot. You return to Powderfuse Port as another shipment approaches.

sections.title: Another Shipment
sections.body: A new shipment is on its way to Powderfuse Port, and Friz Frazzlespark is waiting there. You return to her in the Riverglades after the Venture Co. has suffered its comeuppance and Friz has received her loot. She calls the transaction smooth. Now Southsea Pirates are due to bring in the next shipment.

faq.answer: Friz Frazzlespark is waiting for you at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

faq.q: What happened to the Venture Co.?
faq.answer: Friz says the Venture Co. got its comeuppance.
Yes. Friz says she has received her loot.
Friz expects another shipment from the Southsea Pirates.

attribution: In-game quest text: All's Well That Ends Well
